:::{#thm-exp-score}
#### Score function of an exponential variable

Let $X$ be an exponential random variable with mean $\pmean$ and observed value $x > 0$.
The [score](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-score) $\score$ of the single observation $x$
is the derivative of its log-likelihood $\loglik$ with respect to $\pmean$.
It equals the deviation of $x$ from the mean $\E{X}$,
divided by the variance $\Var{X}$:

$$\score = \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}} = \frac{x - \pmean}{\pmean^2}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-exp-score-fn, worked in @sol-exp-score-fn.

:::
